name: alfasix/alfakit-invoices
description: Invoices, quotes, credit notes and receipts for AlfaKit panels: exact integer money in any currency, inclusive, exclusive and compound taxes, atomic per-tenant numbering, live server-side totals, payments, overdue tracking, a branded print-ready document with a pluggable PDF renderer and a signed customer view link.

suggest.barryvdh/laravel-dompdf: Render invoices as PDF files with Dompdf (used automatically when installed).
suggest.dompdf/dompdf: Render invoices as PDF files with Dompdf (used automatically when installed).
suggest.spatie/laravel-pdf: Render invoices as PDF files with headless Chrome, best for right-to-left scripts (used automatically when installed).
suggest.alfasix/alfakit-billing: A "Pay now" button on the customer invoice page through your billing provider.

tour: Create an invoice with live totals
highlights: Invoices, quotes, credit notes and receipts
Exact integer money in any currency
Branded document and signed customer link
